Overview
The mountain does not forgive.
It remembers.
Climboria is a vertical open-world where every meter is earned. No portals, no shortcuts. You climb with hands, rope, and will. At the top, the Sky Castle waits — but only those who conquer blizzards, avalanches, and thin air will enter.

→ Open full Overview folder

Physics Climb

Real grip, stamina, rope tension. One slip = 100m fall.

Live Mountain

Dynamic weather, day-night, avalanches triggered by sound.

On-Chain Legend

Every summit is minted. Your banner lives forever.

The Game
Climb. Survive. Conquer.

🪢 Expedition

Choose route, gear, team. Alpine, Ice, or Death Zone — each needs different strategy.

🏕️ Camp & Craft

Build camps, melt ice, craft gear. Oxygen matters above 8000m.

🏰 Castle Siege

Final 500m is PvP — who plants banner first owns the season.

How it works

• Buy $CLIMB on pump.fun style curve
• Use to buy gear, rope, oxygen
• Summit = earn $CLIMB + NFT banner
• Top 100 climbers share seasonal vault
• Holders vote next mountain
